_note: Zone 7 site catalogue (World & Level). Positions use the raid.json convention: radius = fraction of playableRadius, bearing in degrees (0 = north = -Z, 90 = east = +X). Every site here is pre-shaped in the terrain; each raid draws which ones are live from its seed (src/world/layout.ts). Counts and open times come from RAID.larva; this file only says where things can be.

geneBlooms._note: Harvest nodes: clusters of DNA-heavy bulbs, opened like a container (loot.json geneBloom). Riskier sites carry the same table; the risk is where they grow.

anomaly._note: One anomaly per Larva raid. gravityMultiplier comes from RAID.host.anomalies (gravityBloom); size is the Larva-scale radius in metres.
